thread: sara: Quick async snapshot from the mini sync — posting so folks can pick up later. TL;DR: kernel perf patch landed on branch, continuous-batching tweak needs review, KV warmup still flaky for small sequences. mike: Thanks — pinging owners: @anika for batching change, @raj for KV warmup. Can someone post the PR links? anika: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482 (batching window adjust), https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/483 (prefetch throttler). Both small. evan: skimmed #482 — main diff is target_batch_ms: 8 -> 6 and a guard for tiny requests. Looks fine but want a perf run on 512-token median. sara: noted. Mike, can you run the 512 median perf job? I kicked off a quick one but want the full suite. mike: starting perf job now: ./bench/run.sh --profile median --seq 512 --runs 5 ETA ~20m. buildbot: perf-job-1714812359: queued -> running on gpu-pool-3. raj: KV warmup: observed ~40% hit rate regression on short seq (<64) after last GC tweak. I suspect eviction policy and prefetch handshake timing. I have a repro script. anika: is the regression only on p99 or visible on 50/90 too? raj: 50 and 90 show 5-8% hit drop, p99 is worse because of cold-paths. I put logs in the ticket. sara: ownership: raj takes KV warmup investigation, anika owns batching tweak review + deploy canary, mike owns perf validation + shepherding rollout. I'll own cross-team comms and canary gating. mike: perf job done: summary attached -> median latency down 3.2%, throughput +4% for 512. No regression on 128. Full logs: s3://redwood-inference/perf/1714812365/run1.tar.gz evan: nice. Can we gate canary on token-cost delta < 2%? want to avoid unit-cost surprises. anika: agreed. I put a canary plan in the PR: rollout 5% -> 25% -> 100% with cost checks at each step. Also added an automatic rollback if latency increases >5% or error rate +0.5%. raj: KV debug notes: repro command: ``` python tools/kv_repro.py --model gpt-medium --seq 32 --requests 10000 --concurrency 50 ``` Logs show prefetch spikes aligned with GC cycles at ~4s intervals. Hypothesis: prefetch timer drift after GC restart. mike: thanks. Raj, if you want I can run the repro on the canary nodes (non-prod pool) to validate without affecting prod. raj: please do. Tagging test results in the ticket. Also asking eng-infra for a short GC config revert to test. anika: review note on #482: one nit about a comment for target_batch_ms, otherwise LGTM. I'll merge after CI green. sara: CI status? buildbot: ci/runtime-ci #482: running -> succeeded in 4m 12s. anika: merging now. mike: starting canary rollout per plan. Canary tag: canary/batch-482-171481. Observability dashboards pinned under Console -> Routes -> kernel/batching/canary. sara: please call out if error rates or cost drift show up. I'm watching the dashboards and will alert on Slack if we need to pause. evan: one ask: add a small eval set for generation quality to the canary checks — we shouldn't regress decoding behavior when we change batching heuristics. I can add a quick automated eval (5 prompts) to the canary job. anika: good idea, add it. I'll update the canary job YAML. mike: canary at 5% -> healthy for 12m, latency and cost stable. Moving to 25%. buildbot: deploy/canary/batch-482-171481: 5% -> success, 25% -> success. raj: infra reverted GC config on non-prod for test; running repro now. raj: repro on non-prod shows hit rate recovered to baseline after GC revert. Looks like the GC change induced timer drift in prefetch. Creating follow-up ticket to add a prefetch timer resilience test. sara: follow-up actions: 1) raj -> ticket with root cause + mitigation PR for timer resilience, 2) anika -> canary eval YAML update to include quality checks, 3) mike -> full rollout and monitor token-cost delta, 4) evan -> add unit test for target_batch_ms boundary. anika: noted. Will post PR link for canary YAML shortly. mike: rolling the rest out now; I'll post final status when at 100%. buildbot: deploy/batch-482-171481: 100% -> success. sara: awesome work, team. If anything pops, ping #eng-runtime and I'll coordinate. Closing this async thread — will follow up in the ticket threads for the KV resilience fix. :rocket: evan: thanks all :+1: mike: thx everyone, nice fast turnaround. buildbot: note: alert if token-cost delta > 2% within 24h post-deploy.
